title: Unauthorized Transaction Disputes — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Disputes Manual
content:
**Disputes manual, Pocketwire Visa Debit Card: unauthorized transactions.**

### Clauses in force

**U-1 Scope.** An unauthorized dispute covers a card purchase or ATM withdrawal that the customer did not make or authorize. A purchase by a family member to whom the customer gave the card is not unauthorized. Neither is a recurring charge the customer signed up for and forgot.

**U-2 Card status.** An unauthorized dispute is filed only on a card whose status is blocked or closed. A card that is still active or locked must therefore be blocked as compromised first. This is judged from the status on the record of the card that made the disputed transaction.

**U-3 Report window.** The dispute is accepted only within the report window: it must be filed no later than the tier's unauthorized dispute report window, in calendar days, after the date of the disputed card transaction. The window is counted in calendar days from the transaction's date. The day after the transaction is day 1, and a dispute filed on the last day is accepted. The transaction date is taken from the transaction's own record.

**U-4 One dispute per transaction.** A transaction can carry only one dispute. A dispute is filed only if no earlier dispute, for any reason, exists on the same card transaction. An unauthorized dispute and a merchant dispute therefore exclude each other on one transaction.

**U-5 Provisional credit timing.** Provisional credit is posted no earlier than the tier's provisional credit period, in business days, after the dispute report date, and only on a dispute whose latest record is still pending. This timing is counted in Federal Reserve business days from the dispute report date. The first business day after the report is day 1, and posting on the day the period is reached qualifies.

**U-6 Heavy dispute history and new cards.** When the customer's disputes filed over the rolling 365 days ending on the filing date already exceed the tier's dispute count, no provisional credit is posted, and the amount is credited only on approval. This count covers all of the customer's cards and does not include the dispute being filed. For a transaction made within the tier's new-card period after the card's activation date, the new-card provisional credit timing and the new-card investigation deadline replace the ordinary timings.

**U-7 Outcomes.** A dispute still pending after the tier's investigation deadline, in business days, is resolved as approved at the next handling. A posted provisional credit is reversed if the dispute is denied, or if the customer withdraws it, which is the customer's own decision. An approval on a dispute that received no provisional credit is paid as a final dispute credit.

### Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this policy are **no longer in force**. Each has been superseded by the current basis, and none is to be applied.

- *Former liability clause:* "Liability is the lower of the dispute amount and the tier's liability cap for timely notice when the dispute is filed within the tier's timely-notice period of Federal Reserve business days after the transaction date, and the lower of the dispute amount and the tier's liability cap for late notice otherwise." No longer in force.
- *Former small-dispute clause:* "A dispute amount at or below the tier's small-dispute threshold is credited in full as final on filing as a final dispute credit and resolved approved the same day, without liability or investigation." No longer in force.
- *Former provisional credit amount clause:* "Otherwise provisional credit of the dispute amount less the liability is posted once the dispute has stayed pending long enough." No longer in force. The timing in U-5 stays in force.
- *Former outcome-recording clause:* "The disputes team records approved or denied." No longer in force. The rest of U-7 stays in force.

### Boundary illustrations (hypothetical)

| Question | Record shows | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| Report window, 60 days | Dispute filed on the 60th day after the transaction date | accepted |
| Report window, 60 days | Dispute filed on the 61st day | not accepted |
| Card status | Card locked | not filed until the card is blocked as compromised |
| Card status | Card blocked or closed | the status condition is met |
| One dispute per transaction | A merchant dispute already exists on the purchase | no unauthorized dispute is filed on it |
| Dispute count 3 | 3 earlier disputes in the 365 days | not above 3, so provisional credit is not withheld on this ground |
| Dispute count 3 | 4 earlier disputes in the 365 days | above 3, so no provisional credit, and credit only on approval |
| Provisional timing, 5 business days | 5th business day after the report date, dispute still pending | posting qualifies |
| Provisional timing, 5 business days | 4th business day after the report date | too early |
